clean_mb_with_errors.lesson: V-51(n,g), tabulated in mb; X4Pro converts to barns and logs the error analysis (dy, dysys, dystat).

clean_fission.lesson: Np-237(n,f), already in barns: the simplest clean cross section.

dysys_larger_than_dy.lesson: Mo-96(n,p): the systematic component dysys exceeds the dy the ingestion keeps.

cm_to_lab.lesson: Li-7(n,el) given in the centre-of-mass frame; X4Pro converts the energy to the laboratory frame.

s_factor.lesson: Charged-particle data tabulated as astrophysical S-factors (b*MeV); X4Pro converts to barns.

production_Mo100_pxn_Tc99m.lesson: Mo-100(p,2n)Tc-99m: the cyclotron route to Tc-99m; the product isomer is only in the REACTION string.

production_Ra226_Ac225.lesson: Ra-226(p,2n)Ac-225: only a handful of points exist.

multi_experiment_fission.lesson: U-235(n,f), flagged as superseded in EXFOR but still in the parquet.

raw_counts_labelled_barns.lesson: Al-27(n,g) RAW: original units NO-DIM (counts); X4Pro relabels them B. Values like 25 'barns'.

arbitrary_units.lesson: H-1 data in arbitrary units relabelled B.

dimensionless_sum.lesson: A sum of angular distributions (MT 0) in NO-DIM.

resonance_widths.lesson: Resonance widths (meV -> eV) sitting in the CrossSection column; resonance energy is the x-axis.

thin_target_approximation.lesson: SF8=TTA: thin-target approximation, an apparent cross section.

raw_with_negative_points.lesson: RAW capture data: 35% of the raw points are <= 0 and are silently deleted at ingestion.

compound_code_evaluated.lesson: Compound code ending EVAL: evaluated values reach the parquet.

compound_code_derived.lesson: Equality code ending DERIV: derived values reach the parquet.

superseded_in_parquet.lesson: Marked superseded in SUBENT.SPSDD, still ingested (the filter compares str with int).

autocorrection_available.lesson: X4Pro computed decay-data correction factors (0.77-1.24) that the ingestion does not apply.

dropped_natural_target.lesson: natNi(d,x)Cu-61, natMo(p,x)Tc-99m, natZn(p,x)Cu-67: natural-element targets (A=0) are dropped.

dropped_branch_qualifier.lesson: SF5 = IND / (CUM): independent and cumulative yields (the isotope-production data type).

dropped_no_usable_points.lesson: Pure by metadata but no usable points.
